name: clear-straight-launch-throttle-v1

scope.primary_change: increase emitted gas from 0.10 to 0.11 only when the inherited clear-straight gate is active and the unchanged pedal controller requested its full-gas 0.08 branch

factor.exact_predicate: inherited pre-adjust gas == MAX_GAS (0.08) AND inherited _GuardedCompletionController output gas == CLEAR_STRAIGHT_MAX_GAS (0.10) AND inherited brake == 0
factor.equivalent_operating_domain: valid visible road, existing straight classification, no detected obstacle, settled residual steering, and estimated speed strictly below current transient target minus 8
factor.call_order: apply after unchanged _pedals and inherited clear-straight scaling; do not alter target computation or controller state

frozen: cruise speed 48, curve formula and floor 36, target EMA and stored target state
pedal branch thresholds, near-target gas, braking boundary speed > target+1, and all brake values
MAX_GAS 0.08 and inherited clear-straight outputs 0.10, 0.066666..., and 0.041666... outside the full-gas branch
obstacle caps 47/40, compound target 30, obstacle detector, pass side, urgency, steering, slew, preview, and transition guard
curve, preview, obstacle-present, residual-steer, invalid, lost-road, DrQ, explicit baseline export, and HAIC paths
model.pt, official environment files, user videos, and root submission.zip

synthetic: At exact estimated-speed values below target-8, including 0 and nextafter(target-8 toward negative infinity), candidate gas is 0.11 while control gas is 0.10 and steering/brake/state are exact.
At target-8 and above through overspeed, complete candidate action and state are bit-exact to control.

Curves including floor-speed curves, distant preview frames, early and near obstacles, compound hazards, obstacle-to-clear settling, residual steering, invalid input, road loss/recovery, and reset remain bit-exact to control.
Mirrored road and obstacle scenes preserve exact steering and longitudinal symmetry; output stays finite, bounded, deterministic, and gas/brake exclusive.
Repeated launch frames differ only in gas and do not create or persist any new state.
regression: All previous stable, compound, curve, guarded, distant-obstacle, anticipatory-preview, and obstacle-priority tests pass.
Bare state-dict routing selects only the new final launch-throttle subclass; DrQ, explicit baseline export, and HAIC paths remain unchanged.
Temporary submission package contains exact candidate agent.py and unchanged model.pt, passes import/action/reset/static-scan/timing/memory gates, and does not overwrite root submission.zip.

abort: Any target speed, target state, brake boundary, brake value, steering, perception, obstacle, curve, preview, or transition behavior changes.
The higher gas applies at or above target-8, with any obstacle, on a curve or preview, before residual steering settles, on invalid/lost road, or outside the bare-state-dict route.
A second parameter, track-specific condition, smoothing state, ramp, latch, or detector change is needed.
Any frozen artifact or user evidence changes, or any relevant interface, package, deterministic-reset, timing, or memory test fails.
Any environment execution, performance claim, submission, or SOTA action occurs while the required governance files are absent.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md, and report.pdf are absent.
Only synthetic diagnostic validation is authorized; the candidate remains INCOMPARABLE.
